domain: APOLLO — typed-state compositional evolutionary engine (Branch C, M2)
one_line: The program's most instrumented subsystem: a typed-blackboard MAP-Elites engine whose five-wall arc (max_acc 0.392→0.833) proved search can exploit hand-supplied representational widenings in ~130 gens but has never found one itself — making Apollo the cleanest testbed for the program's new central question (can widening be mechanized) rather than a discovery engine.
purpose_and_thesis: Founding thesis: "the forge builds atoms; I build molecules" — evolve multi-tier reasoning organisms (pipelines of forge R-atom primitives) where evolution finds the routing and an ablation gate ensures every atom is load-bearing or the molecule dies (roles/Apollo/CHARTER.md). Branch C (post-2026-05-24) reframed the genome as typed state→state transformers on a shared BlackboardState (explicit slot vocabulary, declared reads/writes, preconditions), replacing the gen-3551 output-wiring DAG that the 2026-05-22 baseline-matrix experiment falsified. Goal: evolve cross-tier organisms (R1 parse + R2 inference + R1 order) de novo, falsification-first at every step.

strategic_read: Apollo is the program's best instrument and its most honest falsifier — and that is precisely why its headline number must not be oversold. The 0.392→0.833 arc is routing gain plus hand-supplied primitives, validated (not discovered) by search: every one of the five widenings was agent-authored, search exploited each in ~130 gens, and the LLM-in-the-loop contributed exactly nothing across 2152 mutations. The composition thesis survives only in its weak form ('given the right operator and ingredients, search assembles the composition' — crossover 4/5 de novo, router in ≤6 gens); the strong form ('evolution discovers the widening') is 5-for-5 falsified and has now been correctly promoted, by Apollo itself, into the program's central question. The right move is the one already queued: stop buying gens (150-gen probes, deterministic only), extract W0 from the existing pivot corpus, and run W1 — a cheap, pre-registered, kill-conditioned test of whether wall-type is readable from telemetry. That experiment recycles Apollo's genuine comparative advantage (the only subsystem with ground-truth-labeled walls) and answers a question that matters beyond Apollo. Secondary hygiene: fix or delete hephaestus_ops.py (it is broken AND its uncommitted diff quietly un-does an honesty fix — a small integrity leak in a program that trades on kill-record honesty), and close the clean-routing debt before citing 0.833 anywhere as 'genuine routing'.
